$comment: Deck slides at 1920 by 1080, each built from a share-image template (brand/assets/image.json) drawn at the slide's size, so a deck shares the posts' layers: the reef, the outline band, hatching, the wordmark tile, the console window, the octopi and the lockup. Bullets is the one layout of its own: the title, points led by the filled check circle (Phosphor CheckCircle, the library's checks) and the lockup, between hatched strips. Opening copy is the editor's (occasions) or an Acme placeholder.
